notes: 3D desks, workstations, cubicles and chairs now look like furniture, in their own colours
Every lift becomes a shaft through the floors, even when the floors' scales differ a little
A picture plan's legend frame no longer stands up as walls in 3D
A cable drawn onto an object's icon now connects to it, and a switch end asks its port
Objects can have up to four network interfaces; a cable asks which one and shows the link speed
The switch screen shows its front and back panels at the top right
Match to Satellite: rotate, zoom and move the plan and the satellite; North up
